discovery.auth: api_key query param issued in developer cabinet

reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence high). RIA.com runs an official developer portal with freemium/paid JSON APIs for AUTO.RIA search, listing info, average price (valuation) and ad posting.

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Personal API key from the developers.ria.com cabinet (Особистий кабінет); sent as the api_key query parameter. auto/info is freemium, statistic-avarage-price is paid.

config_fields.name: user_id
config_fields.help: Your RIA user id (integer); required by get_valuation (auto/statistic-avarage-price takes user_id and api_key in the query).

adapter.terms: RIA.com developer API (developers.ria.com): freemium/paid limits per key; the phone number of the seller is never returned.

get_listing.note: GET https://developers.ria.com/auto/info?api_key&auto_id=<ad id> (freemium). price is the USD price (UAH and EUR are in raw); autoData holds year, race (mileage text), fuelName, gearboxName; stateData.regionName, photoData, seoLinkM and the VIN (only if the seller made it public) stay in raw. The seller's phone is always masked.

get_valuation.note: PAID. POST https://developers.ria.com/auto/statistic-avarage-price/?user_id&api_key {langId: 4, period: 365, params: {omniId: <VIN>}} — search by unique identifier ('available only if the car was advertised on the site'). Pass `vin` (a state plate or AUTO.RIA ad id also work as omniId). Returns a price history, not a band: raw.graphData[] = {date: 'YYYY-MM', price: {UAH, USD}} over the last 365 days; low/mid/high stay null.

not_offered.search_listings: GET /auto/search returns only ad ids (search_result.ids is a list of strings) that each need an auto/info call; the runtime maps object rows only and does not fan out, so search is not served.
not_offered.decode_vin: No VIN decoder in the AUTO.RIA API (VIN is only a search filter / ad field).
not_offered.list_dealers: No dealer directory endpoint in the developers.ria.com used-cars reference.
not_offered.me: No identity endpoint for an API key.

evidence: host developers.ria.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.2 (GoDaddy.com, Inc.)
probe: 2/2 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 2/2 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
